anomalies.observed: The second LED of dual LED D30 (K2/A2) is wired with its anode (A2, pin 4) on ESTOP_OUT and its cathode (K2, pin 2) through R60 back to ESTOP_OUT (R60 pin 2 is on ESTOP_OUT). Both ends of the LED branch sit on the same node, so the LED cannot conduct. The first channel is wired correctly, with K1 through R59 to GND.
anomalies.expected: The K2 branch should return through its series resistor to ground, matching the K1 branch (R59 from D30 K1 to GND). Otherwise the e-stop indicator channel is non-functional.
anomalies.impact: The e-stop status LED channel driven by K2 never lights, so the operator gets no indication for that state. The LED loop also sits across the e-stop output line.

anomalies.observed: Net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW connects only the anodes of three indicator LEDs (D4, D14, D23). No source, switch or regulator output is on this net, so the LEDs have no supply. The companion net /LED_3.3V_POWER_NONINV does have a driven source (U34 pin 4).
anomalies.expected: A switched 3.3V supply should feed the anodes of the ETH and PI activity LEDs, as the net name indicates.
anomalies.impact: The Ethernet link/activity LEDs and the PI activity LED never light, because their anode rail is not connected to any supply.

anomalies.observed: R36 is valued 24k, but its MPN FRC0805J240TSD and its description both state 24 Ω (240 code). The SPICE deck also uses 24k.
anomalies.expected: The value field should agree with the part's own MPN and description. A 24 Ω resistor across the supercap stack would be a very heavy bleed, so the value and part identity disagree.

evidence.quote: (description " 125mW Thick Film Resistors 150V ±100ppm/℃ ±5% 24Ω 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS")

anomalies.impact: If the 24 Ω part was fitted, the output stack is bled far harder than designed; if 24k is correct, the MPN and description are wrong. Either way the bill of materials and the circuit do not agree.

parsed.summary: The netlist shows an e-stop LED branch whose cathode resistor is tied back to its own anode node, so that LED cannot conduct. Several indicator-LED anodes also sit on a switched 3.3V rail that has no supply. The R36 value conflicts with its own MPN and description. These are plausible but not conclusive deviations.
